description: Source code for WAN Manager IPC handling, including message processing, socket communication, and interface management.

methods.name: WanMgr_IpcNewIpv4Msg
methods.description: Processes new IPv4 DHCP messages, allocates and copies data to interface structures.

methods.name: WanMgr_IpcNewIpv6Msg
methods.description: Processes new IPv6 DHCP messages, allocates and copies data to interface structures.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetInterfaceStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of a network interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_IpcNewIhcMsg
methods.description: Handles new IHC messages, updates system events and telemetry based on message type.

methods.name: Wan_ForceRenewDhcpIPv4
methods.description: Triggers DHCPv4 renewal via DHCP manager or signal process.

methods.name: Wan_ForceRenewDhcpIPv6
methods.description: Triggers DHCPv6 renewal via DHCP manager or signal process.

methods.name: IpcServerThread
methods.description: Thread function that creates a socket, binds, and processes incoming IPC messages.

methods.name: WanMgr_RemoveSingleQuote
methods.description: Removes single quotes from a string (used in IPv6 domain name processing).

methods.name: WanMgr_SendMsgToIHC
methods.description: Sends messages to the IPoE Health Check component via nanomsg socket.
